opinions: I BELIEVE FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN FULLY INTEGRATE INTO THEIR NEW COUNTRY WITH TIME AND EFFORT.
I THINK IT'S POSSIBLE TO BE PROUD OF ONE'S COUNTRY OF BIRTH WHILE RECOGNIZING ITS FLAWS AND COMPLEXITIES.
I AGREE THAT THERE ARE NO SAVAGE AND CIVILIZED PEOPLES, ONLY DIFFERENT CULTURES.
I THINK IT'S IMPORTANT TO CONFRONT AND PROCESS TROUBLES RATHER THAN DISTRACTING ONESELF WITH MORE CHEERFUL THINGS.
I BELIEVE IN THE POTENTIAL FOR REHABILITATION FOR ALL INDIVIDUALS, REGARDLESS OF THEIR PAST ACTIONS.
I AGREE THAT CORPORATIONS REQUIRE REGULATION TO ENSURE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
I STRONGLY DISAGREE WITH THE NOTION THAT ANY RACE HAS SUPERIOR QUALITIES COMPARED TO OTHERS.
I BELIEVE THAT THE MORALITY OF SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS A PERSONAL AND CULTURAL MATTER, NOT UNIVERSALLY IMMORAL.
I THINK THOSE ABLE TO WORK SHOULD CONTRIBUTE, BUT SOCIETY SHOULD ALSO PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR THOSE IN NEED.
I DISAGREE WITH THE NOTION THAT SPANKING IS AN ACCEPTABLE FORM OF DISCIPLINE FOR CHILDREN.
I STRONGLY SUPPORT THE RIGHT OF SAME-SEX COUPLES TO ADOPT CHILDREN.
I BELIEVE A ONE-PARTY STATE IS DETRIMENTAL TO PROGRESS AND INDIVIDUAL FREEDOMS.
I THINK CHILDREN SHOULD LEARN DISCIPLINE, BUT ALSO CRITICAL THINKING AND INDEPENDENCE.
I BELIEVE CIVIL LIBERTIES SHOULD BE PROTECTED, EVEN IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM.
I BELIEVE MOTHERS SHOULD HAVE THE FREEDOM TO CHOOSE BETWEEN CAREER AND HOMEMAKING.
I DISAGREE THAT MORALITY IS SOLELY DEPENDENT ON RELIGION.
I BELIEVE PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR ADULTS.
I SUPPORT THE DECRIMINALIZATION OF MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE.
I BELIEVE COMPANIES HAVE A SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY BEYOND PROFIT TO SHAREHOLDERS.
I DISAGREE WITH SEGREGATING PEOPLE BASED ON DIFFERENCES; DIVERSITY ENRICHES SOCIETY.
I BELIEVE IN SUPPORTING ONE'S COUNTRY WHEN IT IS RIGHT, BUT NOT BLINDLY.
I DISAGREE WITH THE CONCEPT OF 'AN EYE FOR AN EYE'; JUSTICE SHOULD FOCUS ON REHABILITATION AND FAIRNESS.
I BELIEVE AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED TO ENSURE ACCOUNTABILITY AND PREVENT ABUSE OF POWER.
I DISAGREE; SOME PEOPLE CAN NATURALLY FEEL HOMOSEXUAL.
I BELIEVE IN QUESTIONING AND CHALLENGING THE ESTABLISHMENT FOR PROGRESS.
I BELIEVE PEOPLE ARE DIVIDED MORE BY CLASS THAN BY NATIONALITY.
I AGREE THAT ECONOMIC GROWTH SHOULD BE BALANCED WITH ENVIRONMENTAL CONSIDERATIONS.
I BELIEVE PUBLIC FUNDING FOR BROADCASTING INSTITUTIONS CAN SUPPORT INDEPENDENT CONTENT.
I AGREE THAT ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION SHOULD SERVE HUMANITY, NOT JUST CORPORATIONS.
I BELIEVE SOCIAL SECURITY IS A MORE RELIABLE MEANS OF HELPING THE DISADVANTAGED THAN CHARITY ALONE.
I DISAGREE; WHAT BENEFITS CORPORATIONS DOESN'T ALWAYS BENEFIT SOCIETY AS A WHOLE.
I BELIEVE THE RICH SHOULD BE TAXED FAIRLY TO SUPPORT SOCIETAL NEEDS.
I BELIEVE ABSTRACT ART SHOULD BE CONSIDERED A VALID FORM OF ARTISTIC EXPRESSION.
I AGREE THAT PRIVATE CONSENSUAL ACTIVITIES BETWEEN ADULTS ARE NOT THE STATE'S BUSINESS.
I DISAGREE; ALL PROFESSIONS CONTRIBUTE VALUE TO SOCIETY IN DIFFERENT WAYS.
I AGREE THAT THE COMMERCIALIZATION OF BASIC NECESSITIES LIKE WATER IS PROBLEMATIC.
I DISAGREE; ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGAL AND ACCESSIBLE UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.
I AGREE THAT A FREE MARKET REQUIRES REGULATION TO PREVENT MONOPOLIES.
I BELIEVE A BALANCED APPROACH IS NEEDED, CONSIDERING BOTH MARKET FREEDOM AND SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITIES.
I DISAGREE; INTERNATIONAL LAW SHOULD BE RESPECTED IN ALL CIRCUMSTANCES.
I DISAGREE; PEOPLE WITH INHERITABLE DISABILITIES SHOULD HAVE THE RIGHT TO REPRODUCE.
I DISAGREE; A CIVILIZED SOCIETY VALUES EQUALITY AND MUTUAL RESPECT, NOT HIERARCHICAL OBEDIENCE.
I AGREE THAT THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT CAN BE CONCERNING.
I BELIEVE IT'S NATURAL FOR CHILDREN TO HAVE SOME PRIVACY FROM THEIR PARENTS.
I BELIEVE DISCUSSIONS ABOUT SEX SHOULD BE OPEN AND INFORMED, NOT EXCESSIVE.
I BELIEVE REHABILITATION SHOULD BE PRIORITIZED OVER PUNISHMENT IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE.
I BELIEVE PROTECTIONISM CAN BE NECESSARY TO PROTECT DOMESTIC INDUSTRIES AND JOBS.
I AGREE THAT GOVERNMENTS SHOULD HOLD BUSINESSES ACCOUNTABLE FOR MISLEADING THE PUBLIC.
I BELIEVE SCHOOLING SHOULD PREPARE STUDENTS FOR LIFE, NOT JUST JOBS.
I DISAGREE WITH THE DEATH PENALTY; LIFE IMPRISONMENT IS A SUFFICIENT PUNISHMENT.
I BELIEVE LAND SHOULD NOT BE TREATED SOLELY AS A COMMODITY.
I AGREE THAT SOCIETAL CONTRIBUTIONS SHOULD BE VALUED OVER MERE FINANCIAL MANIPULATION.
I DISAGREE; PUBLIC FUNDING FOR ARTS INSTITUTIONS CAN ENRICH SOCIETY.
I BELIEVE HEALTHCARE SHOULD BE ACCESSIBLE TO ALL, REGARDLESS OF ABILITY TO PAY.
I DISAGREE; ALLIANCES SHOULD BE BASED ON SHARED VALUES, NOT CONVENIENCE.
I DISAGREE; ASTROLOGY LACKS SCIENTIFIC VALIDITY.
I BELIEVE SCHOOLS SHOULD BE INCLUSIVE AND NOT IMPOSE SPECIFIC RELIGIOUS VALUES.
I DISAGREE; LUCK IS NOT A DETERMINANT OF ONE'S SUCCESS OR FAILURE.
I DISAGREE; CLASSROOM ATTENDANCE IS IMPORTANT FOR EDUCATION.
I DISAGREE; SURVEILLANCE SHOULD BE REGULATED TO PROTECT EVERYONE'S PRIVACY.
I BELIEVE BOTH INFLATION AND UNEMPLOYMENT NEED TO BE CONTROLLED FOR ECONOMIC STABILITY.
I AGREE THAT THE PRINCIPLE 'FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED' IS FUNDAMENTALLY GOOD.
